description: arXiv:2610.28184v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reasoning-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) driving models can perceive and reason about safety-critical hazards yet fail to translate that evidence into safe actions. We characterize this failure as a perception-action binding gap: hazard information is available inside the model but exerts insufficient control over trajectory generation....
author: Matteo Cercola, Katie Z Luo, Simone Formentin, Marco Pavone
